heroDescription: Build your character, meet the community and create stories worth remembering. Craic Mountain brings Irish-inspired roleplay, active departments and a strong community atmosphere together in one place.
announcement: Welcome to Craic Mountain! Join our community and get involved.

rules.title: Respect everyone
rules.description: No harassment, hate speech, discrimination or bullying. Treat players and staff fairly.

rules.title: Stay in character
rules.description: Use in-character communication during scenes. Keep out-of-character disputes out of active roleplay.

rules.title: No metagaming
rules.description: Do not use information your character has not learned through roleplay.

rules.title: No powergaming
rules.description: Allow others a fair chance to respond. Do not force actions or unrealistic outcomes on other players.

rules.title: Value your life
rules.description: Respond realistically to dangerous situations and allow scenes to unfold naturally.

rules.title: Follow staff guidance
rules.description: Use the appropriate support channel for issues and appeal decisions respectfully.

departments.title: Garda Response
departments.description: Protect the community and respond to incidents through realistic, team-based scenarios.

departments.title: Medical Services
departments.description: Deliver first aid and emergency care through immersive medical roleplay.

departments.title: Fire & Rescue
departments.description: Take on rescues, emergencies, and teamwork under pressure.

departments.title: Civilian Life
departments.description: Build businesses, meet people and create your own story.

departments.title: Mechanics
departments.description: Keep the city moving through repairs and vehicle services.

events.title: Community Meet & Greet
events.description: Meet other members, have the craic and learn how to get started.

events.title: Open Recruitment Night
events.description: Discover departments and speak with recruitment teams.

events.title: Community Convoy Night
events.description: Join a casual evening of community-led stories.
